assessment_summary: Validation approach: (1) Confirmed the installed commit (6394d99, clean tree) and toolchain match the guide's pinned versions (Node v24.15.0/pnpm 11.3.0 per .nvmrc/packageManager; pnpm check:toolchain-consistency exit 0). (2) Verified infrastructure: Postgres 16 + Redis 7 containers healthy (pg_isready, redis PONG), Redis TLS certs generated. (3) Verified the data layer in-container: goose migrations at v102, 68 IAM tables including every table the doctor's schema guard checks, seeded instances de-musterhausen/bb-guben with hostnames, graphile_worker schema, sva_app/sva_job_worker roles. (4) Verified the app is running with exactly the local-builder profile env (SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE, SVA_MOCK_AUTH, VITE_SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE) and serving real SSR content on :3000. (5) Exercised the actual user flow end-to-end with curl: login redirect, dev-login with CSRF → sva_dev_auth cookie, authenticated /auth/me (200, mock system_admin user for de-musterhausen) and DB-backed /api/v1/iam/me/context (200); /admin/users 200 when authed. (6) Ran the repo's own diagnostics: env:status (infra reported up), env:doctor:local-builder --json (structured 19-check output, 9 ok), env:smoke (fails on the same auth contract). (7) For each non-passing item, independently determined root cause rather than relying on the installer's caveats: the 503 readiness traces to checkKeycloak() → KeycloakUserAttributeReader.listRoles() against KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_BASE_URL=127.0.0.1:8081 plus the tenant-login-contract probe for OIDC secrets — a live Keycloak is structurally absent from the self-contained local-builder profile (checked-in compose defines only app/provisioner/migrate/bootstrap/candidate/redis/postgres; local Keycloak is an external service), and both the configured and unconfigured env branches yield not-ready, so the 503 is environment-intrinsic. The smoke/doctor auth errors trace to a repo-internal contract drift: the checked-in smoke script (runtime-health-smoke.ts:19,37) expects '/?auth=mock-login' and user name 'Builder Mock User', while the checked-in app implements the dev-login cookie flow (auth-route-handlers.ts:1156, mock-auth.ts) whose mock user has no name field. Git proves both files were last modified in the identical installed commit and the tree is clean, so no installation or configuration action could have prevented or fixed this; the real user flow was shown to work end-to-end. The mainserver smoke is absent only because the external mainserver does not exist in the workspace, correctly marked non-blocking via SVA_MAINSERVER_REQUIRED=false (doctor reports it skipped). env:status showing app:null is a cosmetic artifact of the app being started via plain 'pnpm nx run serve' instead of the repo's state-file runner; process and endpoints were independently confirmed. One historical module-resolution error in the serve log predates the completed pnpm build (dist entries now exist; no recurrences). Checks that could not be completed: live Keycloak-dependent paths (OIDC tenant logins, realm provisioning) and remote studio gates — out of scope for the self-contained profile chosen for this environment. Overall: the installation is complete for every component installable in this environment and the software demonstrably operates (UI, auth, IAM context, DB, Redis, job worker), while every failing check is attributable to pre-existing source-level drift or external dependencies, not to incomplete or broken installation.
